# Wan VAE snapshot

Source: https://github.com/modelscope/DiffSynth-Studio/tree/03615819a6209a198c7e4020988a18ba64e05fb0

The copied `wan_video_vae.py` is byte-for-byte identical to `diffsynth/models/wan_video_vae.py` at the recorded revision. It supplies `WanVideoVAE`, normalized posterior-mean encoding, and decoding. Use `distill_codec.integrations.snapshots:create_wan_encoder` or `create_wan_decoder`; do not edit this file to adapt checkpoint layouts.
